d:
The Heat defeated the Pistons, 137-117 tonight in Miami. Giannis Antetokounmpo contributed a team-high 34 points to go with 3 blocks 14 rebounds and 8 assists, with Klay Thompson of the Heat adding an additional 26 points (10-17 FG, 6-11 3P) in the game. Cade Cunningham finished with a team-high 33 points along with 8 assists for the Pistons in the losing effort. The Heat improve their record to 7-6 with the win, while the Pistons fall to 8-4 for the season.
